remarks: Great location! Bright and spacious corner unit featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. 1230 Square Feet. The unit offers a large living room with sliders leading to a private balcony, a kitchen with brand-new appliances, brand-new flooring, a walk-in closet, and plenty of additional closet space. Convenient laundry facilities are available on each floor. The building features an elevator and exercise room. Rent includes heat, hot and cold water, and cooking gas. Ideally located within walking distance to the Springdale Metro-North Station and close to the Merritt Parkway, public transportation, shopping, restaurants, and more. No pets.
